career_ladder.note: Constables in Gujarat Police are initially recruited on a fixed pay stipend of ₹26,000 per month (revised by the State Finance Department from ₹19,950) for an initial probationary service of 5 years. Upon successful completion of 5 years, candidates are absorbed into regular state service in 7th Pay Matrix Level 2 with regular annual increments and promotional avenues.

exam_scheme.note: Gujarat Police recruitment was revised in 2024 by the Home Department to unify the physical tests and introduce a comprehensive 200-mark OMR objective test with negative marking (-0.25 per wrong answer).

financial_package.note: Initial 5 years of service are under the State Government Fix Pay scheme at ₹26,000 per month (revised from ₹19,950). On completion of 5 years of satisfactory service, candidates are placed on regular Pay Matrix Level 2 (₹19,900 basic pay) with full 7th CPC allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Government of Gujarat, Home Department & Finance Department; Gujarat Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules (7th Pay Commission Level 2)
financial_package.estimate_note: Ranges reflect regular Level 2 basic pay (₹19,900) with 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025), HRA (10% to 30% depending on city classification), uniform and special police allowances, minus standard employee NPS and insurance deductions. During the initial 5-year fixed pay period, monthly remuneration is fixed at ₹26,000.
official_perks: Government police quarters / housing accommodation (or HRA in lieu thereof)
Medical expense reimbursement under Gujarat State Employees Medical Scheme
State Government Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) and Group Insurance Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Gujarat Civil Services Rules
Special duty / risk allowance applicable to SRPF and tactical postings

competition_benchmarks.note: Gujarat Police Lokrakshak recruitment represents one of the largest competitive recruitment drives in Gujarat, routinely attracting over 1 million applicants across the state.

years.source_label: Gujarat Police Recruitment Board (GPRB) Advt GPRB/202324/1: 12,733 constable vacancies notified; over 11.5 lakh online applications received on OJAS.

Lokrakshak Recruitment Board (LRB) 2021-22 cycle: 10,459 vacancies; approx. 12 lakh registered candidates; 2,94,845 candidates qualified the physical test (PET) and appeared for the OMR written examination on April 10, 2022.

official_downloads.note: The primary web portal for online application and notifications is Gujarat OJAS. Historical domain lrdgujarat2021.in from the 2021 cycle is defunct with an expired certificate, with all active recruitment operated via ojas.gujarat.gov.in and police.gujarat.gov.in.
